defs.meaning: [试验]实验；尝试（experiment 的 ing 形式）

examples.en: In 1857 Mendel started experimenting with peas in his monastery garden.
examples.zh: 1857年孟德尔开始在其修道院菜园里用豌豆做实验。

examples.en: I enjoyed experimenting with colours – it took me back to being five years old.
examples.zh: 我喜欢尝试各种颜色–这使我回忆起5岁时的情景。

examples.en: Another start-up, TAT, has begun experimenting with a software called "Add Identity".
examples.zh: 另一家新兴公司 TAT 已经开始尝试一种名为“增加身份”的软件。
